categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Haozhi Industrial Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-end core functional components for CNC machine tools, industrial robots, and new energy vehicles. Its main product lines include spindles, rotary tables, linear motors, CNC systems, harmonic reducers, servo motors, servo drives, sensors, encoders, hydrogen fuel cell compressors, and high-speed fans. The company also provides repair and spare parts services and has expanded into intelligent manufacturing equipment and smart robotics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high-speed electric spindles with integrated motors, harmonic drive reducers with proprietary gear designs, permanent magnet synchronous linear motors, and modular platform designs. It employs precision manufacturing processes, including ultra-precision machining and assembly, and maintains multiple national and provincial R&D centers. The company integrates digital control systems, servo drives, and motion control algorithms, and emphasizes in-house production of critical components to ensure quality and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include CNC machine tool manufacturers, industrial robot system integrators, and end-users in industries such as electronics (PCB manufacturing), automotive, aerospace, medical devices, and consumer electronics. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with significant sales to manufacturing sectors requiring high-precision machining and automation solutions. Its products are widely used in PCB drilling and forming machines, metal and glass engraving machines, machining centers, and hydrogen fuel cell systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major sales in South China, East China, Southwest China, North China, Central China, Northeast China, and Northwest China. It has significant overseas operations through its wholly-owned subsidiaries and acquisitions, notably the Infranor Group headquartered in Switzerland, with subsidiaries and sales offices across Europe (Switzerland, France, Germany, Spain, Italy, UK), the United States, and Hong Kong. The company is expanding its international sales channels in India, Southeast Asia, Israel, Korea, Vietnam, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Haozhi Industrial Co., Ltd. operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of core functional components for high-end equipment manufacturers. It designs, develops, and produces critical parts such as spindles, reducers, motors, and control systems that are integrated into CNC machine tools, industrial robots, and fuel cell systems. The company also provides after-sales repair and maintenance services, positioning itself as a key component supplier and service provider within the industrial equipment manufacturing ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent innovation and technology development, focusing on enhancing product performance and expanding applications in CNC machine tools, robotics, and new energy vehicles. It invests heavily in R&D, maintaining national and provincial technology centers and collaborating with universities and research institutes. Key R&D directions include ultra-high-speed spindles, harmonic reducers, linear motors, servo systems, intelligent control systems, and hydrogen fuel cell compressors. The company also emphasizes modular design, cost optimization, and intellectual property protection to sustain competitive advantages.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of high-end core functional components such as spindles, rotary tables, linear motors, servo motors, and control systems. The company also earns income from repair and maintenance services, spare parts sales, and equipment leasing. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels supplemented by distributors, with a growing emphasis on international markets. Additionally, the company receives government subsidies and grants related to technology development, which contribute to other income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the spindle industry and a significant player in the high-end CNC machine tool components and industrial robot parts sectors. It competes with international top-tier brands in precision spindles, harmonic reducers, and servo systems. The company leverages its strong R&D capabilities, cost advantages, and comprehensive product portfolio to maintain a competitive position against both domestic and global competitors. Its acquisition of the Infranor Group enhances its technological and market reach, strengthening its global industry positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.31 billion, representing a 30.63% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 82.9 million, a significant turnaround from a loss in the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.63 billion, growing 8.05% from the prior year. R&D investment increased to over RMB 121 million, accounting for 9.29% of revenue, supporting sustained innovation and growth. The company maintains a stable financial position with improving profitability and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high precision, reliability, and advanced technology in its products, offering comprehensive solutions for high-end CNC machine tools, robotics, and fuel cell systems. Its products feature superior performance metrics such as ultra-high spindle speeds, high torque density, and compact, modular designs. The company combines domestic manufacturing cost advantages with international-level quality and service, providing customers with cost-effective, high-performance components. Its extensive patent portfolio and continuous innovation underpin its competitive differentiation and ability to meet evolving customer demands.
